meta.title: Your responsible partner | Kesla
meta.description: Kesla is your responsible partner in modern forest technology and material handling. Truck and stationary cranes, logging equipment and tractor equipment, made in Finland since 1960.

hero.intro: Kesla is your responsible partner in modern forest technology and material handling. Our innovative, high-quality professional machinery, made in Finland with decades of experience and customer understanding, helps you succeed, in and outside the forest.
